card.fires_on: Responds on the last piece of a name, option or number where a comma or similar punctuation is expected next, as in citation author lists, command flags and dose lists.

modes.description: The end of a surname right before 'et al.' or 'and' in a reference list.

modes.label: Dose and label phrases
modes.description: Words or numbers in dosing text just before a comma or break.

card.writes: It suppresses comma-like tokens, so it lowers the chance that a comma comes next.
card.plain: It fires where the text is mid-item and the model should not put a comma yet, such as inside a citation name or a command line.
